detailed_descriptions.en: In this DLC, you can: Find new resource! Diamonds Creek claim grounds are full of precious gems that you can find in your gold pan and washplants. Sell the gems for some extra cash to upgrade your setup or spend them on cool skins in the paint shop! Don't forget to install the new Gems traps in your Tier 3, otherwise the water will wash them all out! Discover new digging spots! The new claim is full of beatiful places to explore and hidden secrets. Landslides, marshlands and open-pit mines, and you might even stumble upon abandoned cave mines! Face new challenges! Clean the obstacles using machines and cables or speed it up with explosions. Manage the flooding water that can easily damage your equipement if you turn the pumps off for too long. Rebuild broken bridges to unlock rich digging spots or fight the overwhelming darkness deep in the mines. Operate the new backhoe loader Take control of a versatile backhoe loader to dig, transport, and shape terrain with precision. Perfect for loading material and speeding up your mining operations early on. Alternative game start Thanks to its progressive development, this map offers many hours of gameplay, providing a great new starting point all the way through to mid-game. It will appeal to both new players and veteran miners. Unravel hidden secrets Valueable equipement like abandoned mining gear, dynamite and tools are hiding around the corners. Don't forget about the powerstation! Once you restore the connection and fuel the supply tank it will provide electicity to every power pole on the parcels! This DLC is your golden opportunity to redefine your mining experience! Don’t miss the chance to take your gold mining to a whole new level with the fourth DLC!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
In this DLC, you can:

Find new resource!

Diamonds Creek claim grounds are full of precious gems that you can find in your gold pan and washplants. Sell the gems for some extra cash to upgrade your setup or spend them on cool skins in the paint shop! Don't forget to install the new Gems traps in your Tier 3, otherwise the water will wash them all out!

Discover new digging spots!

The new claim is full of beatiful places to explore and hidden secrets. Landslides, marshlands and open-pit mines, and you might even stumble upon abandoned cave mines!

Face new challenges!

Clean the obstacles using machines and cables or speed it up with explosions. Manage the flooding water that can easily damage your equipement if you turn the pumps off for too long. Rebuild broken bridges to unlock rich digging spots or fight the overwhelming darkness deep in the mines.

Operate the new backhoe loader

Take control of a versatile backhoe loader to dig, transport, and shape terrain with precision. Perfect for loading material and speeding up your mining operations early on.

Alternative game start

Thanks to its progressive development, this map offers many hours of gameplay, providing a great new starting point all the way through to mid-game. It will appeal to both new players and veteran miners.

Unravel hidden secrets

Valueable equipement like abandoned mining gear, dynamite and tools are hiding around the corners. Don't forget about the powerstation! Once you restore the connection and fuel the supply tank it will provide electicity to every power pole on the parcels!


This DLC is your golden opportunity to redefine your mining experience! Don’t miss the chance to take your gold mining to a whole new level with the fourth DLC!
